description: List the votings (głosowania) held during one plenary sitting (posiedzenie), in order, with voting number, date and time, title, topic, kind, required majority and the number of YES, NO and ABSTAIN votes. A sitting often has over a hundred votings, so they are returned 50 per page; narrow them to one day of the sitting with date, or by subject with title. Get the breakdown by club with get-voting; find votings across sittings with search-votings.

date.description: Only votings held on this day of the sitting (one of its `dates` in get-proceedings), in YYYY-MM-DD format

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 50

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

proceeding.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

title.description: Only votings whose title, topic or description contains all these words, in Polish, e.g. budżet or poprawka; case and diacritics are ignored, and a stem such as podatk also matches podatku and podatkowy

name: get-votings

date.description: Date and time of the voting

kind.description: ELECTRONIC, TRADITIONAL or ON_LIST (voting on a list of options)

majorityType.description: Majority required, e.g. SIMPLE_MAJORITY or ABSOLUTE_MAJORITY

votingNumber.description: Voting number within the sitting, used by get-voting

nextOffset.description: Pass as `offset` to get the next page; absent on the last page

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before this page

total.description: Number of matching items on all pages

title: List votings of a sitting
